messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: High token delta observed for tenant 'Aventis' in VPC eu-west-1 (dedicated-pool-42). Token count spike +320% over baseline. Paging on-call.

alice-oncall: ack, I'm on it. grabbing logs and metrics now — assigning to SRE.

fiona-sre: joining. can you paste the alert link and affected routes?

alice-oncall: alert: https://internal.alerts/1920033333 — affected: /v1/generate (model:rwd-llama-70b), customer tenant id: t-aventi-001, started ~10:22 UTC.

sam-eng-ml: quick note — we pushed tokenizer change in the infra-layer yesterday (tokenizer-lib v2.1 -> v2.2) but only to hosted. VPC autopush was gated; need to check.

dylan-infra: checking cluster packages for dedicated-pool-42... grep shows tokenizer-lib: v2.1 on instances. hmm.

carla-custeng: Customer reports sudden billing surge, they called support. They say their app didn't change. Need temporary mitigation asap.

fiona-sre: pulled a sample request/response. payload contains some mixed utf-8 and legacy windows-1252 chars, looks like weird replacement characters in the logs. tokenization appears to split multi-byte sequences differently, producing ~3x tokens for same input.

sam-eng-ml: paste of tokenizer compare output:
```
# sample text (redacted)
input: "Invoice – – \u2013 2026-03-15\n"
tokenizer-v2.1 -> ["Invoice"," ","–"," ","–"," ","\u2013"," ","2026","-","03","-","15"] (12 tokens)
tokenizer-v2.2 -> ["Invoice"," \u2013\u2013 ","2026-03-15"] (3 tokens)
```
This is inverted from alert: our infra tokenizers should be producing fewer tokens but cluster shows more. suspicious.

dylan-infra: collect region-level model shards: /dedicated/pool-42 shows lib mismatch across nodes: some nodes have a locally vendor-installed tokenizer adapter patch (internal: tok-normalize patch) applied, others don't.

alice-oncall: hypothesis: customer traffic is hitting nodes with older adapter that treats some byte sequences as separate tokens. Mixed fleet => token counts inconsistent. Could explain per-tenant spike if routing pushed Avnetis to specific cohort.

carla-custeng: Customer says their requests originate from a new client version that sends NFD unicode (decomposed). If our ingestion normalizes to NFC in some nodes but not others, token counts will diverge. They need a short-term mitigation.

fiona-sre: mitigation plan: 1) route Aventis to fallback model variant with tokenizer-normalizer=on on all nodes (safe, same model family) 2) mark affected nodes as draining from dedicated pool 3) enable request-level normalization in ingress LB as emergency transformer.

sam-eng-ml: putting together a small patch that forces unicode normalization (NFC) at pre-tokenize step. small JS/Python shim we can hotpatch at ingress. Will push to canary in 2–3m.

dylan-infra: canary patch applied to 2 nodes in eu-west-1; running synthetic check against sample corpus. results: token counts now stable and close to expected.

alice-oncall: applying routing rule to send Aventis to canary nodes now (temporary). update: routing change applied. monitor for 5m.

eva-billing: heads up from billing: we are already seeing an invoice delta window flag for Aventis. If token counts stay high we'll need to prepare crediting and a customer-facing explanation. hold off on automatic charge until we confirm root cause.

carla-custeng: I'm drafting a customer message: short note + ETA for fix. Will include offer for credit and ask for sample payloads.

mark-pm: add note that Dedicated customers are affected; include next steps in status page. We need an incident priority and ETA for rollback or full fix.

fiona-sre: monitoring: after routing, token ingestion for tenant t-aventi-001 dropped from median 3.2x to 1.05x baseline. latency unaffected.

sam-eng-ml: patch is simple; will prepare full rollout: normalize at ingress, and plan a coordinated tokenizer adapter rollout to uniform version across dedicated fleet. Need infra window to update all nodes in pool-42.

dylan-infra: ETA for full fleet update with zero-downtime drain/rebuild: ~90m. Can do urgent fast-path but may need longer for QA.

alice-oncall: next steps checklist: 1) keep Aventis routed to canary until fleet uniform; 2) schedule fleet patch (dylan + sam) 3) billing hold + provisional credit (eva) 4) customer comms (carla) 5) follow-up postmortem (mark).

eva-billing: prepared provisional credit calc: using delta window we estimate ~$42k of overcharge risk. propose initial credit of 50% pending postmortem.

carla-custeng: customer accepted contact and temporary routing. they provided 3 sample requests that reproduce the high tokenization — sent to eng-ml secure share.

sam-eng-ml: replicating locally now, verifying Unicode normalization fix. If good, I'll push full ingress shim to all load balancers.

incident-coordinator-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-2026-0412-Aventis-TokenizerMismatch; priority P1-customer-impact; runbook link: https://internal.incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0412.

fiona-sre: milestone: Can we keep this open as active incident until fleet update completes?

alice-oncall: yes. I'll stay on call until handoff at 11:15 UTC. @mark-pm please schedule postmortem lead.

mark-pm: I'll own postmortem. folks, please add notes to incident doc. we'll want RCA to include why routing concentrated this tenant on legacy nodes.

sam-eng-ml: rolling ingress shim to all region LB nodes now. progress: 30% -> 100% in 12m. verifying token counts for top 5 tenants: Aventis now normalized across requests.

dylan-infra: starting maintainance window to upgrade tokenizer adapter on dedicated-pool-42 nodes; rolling drain in progress.

alice-oncall: customer-facing update drafted (carla): short apology, root-cause summary (tokenizer inconsistency across nodes), mitigation (routing + normalization), next steps (fleet uniform rollout + credit). ready to send after a quick legal review.

eva-billing: place hold on automatic charges for t-aventi-001 for the window 10:22–11:00 UTC. will prepare provisional credit note.

carla-custeng: sent message to customer with offer for 50% provisional credit. customer ack'd and asked for final postmortem.

alice-oncall: closing the active mitigation: routing removed, fleet uniform, token counts stable. keeping incident open for postmortem and billing confirm.

incident-coordinator-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring.

mark-pm: thanks all. please add timeline + logs to INCIDENT-2026-0412 doc. we'll run RCA & follow-ups and schedule customer review. :white_check_mark:
